corrections.why: Register calls it a tree tower and the Pennsylvania list calls it a tree observation post

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Pennsylvania has two First Mountain sites: this Centre County tree post (1917) and a separate Clinton County wood tower (1911). The story covers only the Centre County site.

notes_for_editor: Thin. The register and the Pennsylvania A-F list agree on 1917 and a tree post about 35 ft up. No source gives staffing, fires, fate beyond 'no longer standing', access or the present-day state. Searches for a Centre County source found nothing; the firelookout.org Pennsylvania inventory returned 404 on fetch, so it is unchecked. The record's coordinates are an approximate GNIS name match and are not verified for this tower. Clinton County First Mountain is a separate 1911 wood tower and must not be merged.
